name: flame.external-mcp/attempt.v2
description: Read a retained external authorization attempt.

name: flame.external-mcp/authorize.v2
description: Begin an authorization attempt against the current enabled entry.

name: flame.external-mcp/change.v2
description: Compare and change one external directory entry.

name: flame.external-mcp/list.v2
description: List external servers and their opaque host launch grants.

name: flame.external-mcp/recover.v2
description: Mark interrupted attempts from earlier Runtime connection epochs as unconfirmed.

name: flame.external-mcp/retire-authorization-start.v2
description: Return the original authorization start decision or retire the command before it can accept an attempt.

name: flame.external-mcp/settle.v2
description: Record the original authorization attempt's terminal result.
